title: macOS eslogger Support — Phase A (OBTS v9 CFP)

questions.prompt: Is building/running the collector → ECS → Sigma detection pipeline (ingesting eslogger output, mapping to ECS, running Nebulock's macos-coresigma Sigma rules, recording the hunt) part of THIS goal, or is this goal scoped to EvidenceForge changes only (emitter + demo scenario), with the external pipeline/recording as a separate downstream step you'll do yourself?
questions.description: The design doc's stated purpose is a citable recorded hunt loop, but EvidenceForge itself only generates data — it doesn't ingest or run detections. Scoping this in would mean this plan also covers standing up ingestion/Sigma tooling and a recording script.
questions.recommendedAnswer: EvidenceForge changes only — emitter, demo scenario, and docs. The collector/ECS/Sigma pipeline and recording are downstream of this goal, done separately.

options.label: EvidenceForge changes only (emitter + demo scenario + docs)
Include the external pipeline + recording in this goal

questions.prompt: The design doc says emitter fields should be "validated against real eslogger captures from talk prep." Do real eslogger NDJSON captures already exist somewhere to use as test fixtures, or should Phase A validate against eslogger's documented schema/public examples instead (no real capture available yet)?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan includes a step to source/copy capture files into tests/fixtures/, or relies on documented schema only.
questions.recommendedAnswer: No captures available yet — validate against eslogger's documented schema/public examples for Phase A; note real-capture validation as a nice-to-have if captures surface before July 25.

options.label: No captures yet — validate against documented schema
I have captures — I'll provide a path

questions.prompt: If July 25 gets tight, what's the first thing to cut from Phase A's scope?
questions.description: Phase A currently includes: macos os_category + world model wiring, eslogger emitter (exec/fork/exit, file ops, openssh/lw_session, sudo/su), BTM causal rule, macos_signing.yaml, modest baseline daemon noise, three-hunt demo scenario, and the full docs/skills/validation/evaluation checklist update.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Baseline daemon noise (Spotlight/Time Machine/softwareupdated/etc.) is the first cut — it's cosmetic realism, not required for the three hunts to be detectable. The three-hunt demo scenario and the core emitter/causal-rule/signing work are the non-negotiable floor.

options.label: Full docs/skills/evaluation checklist (do a minimal subset, backfill after)
Nothing — all of Phase A is the floor

questions.prompt: Is drafting the actual CFP submission text (talk abstract/outline) part of this goal, or purely the code/data implementation?
questions.description: "Work on the obts draft" could mean the design/implementation (what I found and rearticulated) or could also include the written conference submission itself.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Code/data implementation only — the CFP abstract text is a separate, non-code task I'll handle myself.
